description: Na₂NiO₃ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NiO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent NiO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 14-18°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.50 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NiO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent NiO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 14-18°. There are two shorter (2.23 Å) and four longer (2.46 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra, edges with six NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent NiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 18°. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.24 Å. Ni is bonded to six O atoms to form NiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent NiO₆ octahedra, and edges with nine NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 14-15°. There are four shorter (1.95 Å) and two longer (1.96 Å) Ni-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four Na and two equivalent Ni atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Ni₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-12°. In the second O site, O is bonded to four Na and two equivalent Ni atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Ni₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-13°.
